name: 달버섯 동굴 정원
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly moon-mushroom cave garden, low-angle composition along a damp cave wall lined with glowing teal mushroom beds and thick moss; open stone path foreground, bioluminescent mushroom light mixes with warm lantern glow from a side alcove, richly detailed wet rock and moss texture, atmospheric mist, polished fantasy concept art, the entire cavern wrapped in painterly cinematic stillness.
